headlines.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
headlines.summary: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

headlines.title: Germany and Ukraine test armed ground robot for frontline deployment
headlines.summary: Remote-controlled and heading for the front lines. ARX Robotics and the Ukrainian company ROBONEERS report completion of the first major system tests.

headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Left-wing Berlin mayor candidate s private Hamas remarks complicate coalition talks
headlines.summary: Elif Eralp's office accidentally returned an interview transcript containing internal comments and annotations.

headlines.title: Burnham 'ready to support' Poundland staff as retailer faces collapse
headlines.summary: Poundland's bosses are filing a notice of intention to appoint administrators to the business.

headlines.title: ‘I’m not a candidate for anything’: What Lagarde told Euronews before quitting the ECB
headlines.summary: Christine Lagarde told Euronews in an exclusive interview in July that she was not a candidate for any political office. Her announcement that she will leave the European Central Bank early, in February 2027, comes just months before France’s presidential election.

headlines.title: Volkswagen logs Q3 operating loss of €5.86 billion on Porsche writedown
headlines.summary: The Volkswagen Group has filed its worst quarterly performance since the height of the Dieselgate scandal in 2015. Share prices climbed in response, however, perhaps because the bad news was so well signposted.

headlines.title: EU governments helpless as energy prices soar to four-year highs
headlines.summary: There's a 'difficult' winter coming, and ministers have few solutions.

headlines.title: US interest rates held steady and economy grows - what it means for you
headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions affect everything from mortgages to car loans

headlines.title: EU lawmakers press Beijing to rein in exports during Beijing visit
headlines.summary: Following a deal to curb Chinese hybrid car imports, EU lawmakers are demanding similar measures in other industrial sectors, warning that Beijing's export-driven economic model threatens European jobs and industries.

headlines.title: US moves to lift sanctions on Russia s shadow fleet could undermine Western pressure on Moscow and help fund its war in Ukraine.
headlines.summary: The US is reportedly considering ways to convert dark tankers into legitimate vessels, allowing them to transport crude oil that is not subject to sanctions.

headlines.title: Carney frames C$1.6B AI investment as national security imperative
headlines.summary: ”We’re not waiting for the future of AI to be decided somewhere else by those we don’t know or … don’t trust,” Carney said ahead of Canada-EU summit.

headlines.title: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
headlines.summary: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

headlines.title: Volkswagen posts €5.8 billion loss as Chinese competition bites
headlines.summary: Europe's largest carmaker Volkswagen said on Thursday it had made a €5.8 billion loss in the third quarter, as it struggles with intense Chinese competition.

headlines.title: EU s Made in Europe push unnerves global auto suppliers
headlines.summary: In shielding Europe s carmakers from Chinese rivals, the EU risks hurting close partners from Turkey and Morocco to Japan and South Korea. Billions in trade and hundreds of thousands of European jobs are at stake.

headlines.title: Meet the front-runners to replace Lagarde
headlines.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos and Klaas Knot bring long records in monetary policy — and sharply different memories of the Draghi years.

headlines.title: Faisal Islam: This Budget was micro and that was deliberate
headlines.summary: Chancellor John Healey's plans fall short of radical action to create a promised new economic model.

headlines.title: Shares mixed after Google parent Alphabet's earnings disappoint
headlines.summary: Ahead of European markets opening, Asian shares and US futures were mixed on Thursday morning, weighed down by some big technology stocks after Google parent Alphabet’s earnings were lower than expected.

headlines.title: What Germany thinks of carmaker Audi s $4 billion deal with Trump
headlines.summary: The luxury carmaker is set to open its first factory in the United States — a move Trump credits to his tariffs. DW examines the German reaction amid a massive auto industry cull at home.

headlines.title: Britain’s spy agency doesn’t know where thousands of its memory sticks are
headlines.summary: Intelligence agency GCHQ acknowledges its plan for keeping track of USB sticks and other devices with potentially sensitive data on were 'not sufficiently robust.'
